population.value: patients with HF classified as NYHA class II to IV and without diabetes, with an ejection fraction (EF) below 40%
population.quote: patients with HF classified as NYHA class II to IV and without diabetes, with an ejection fraction (EF) below 40%

sample_size.quote: This randomized controlled trial included 130 patients

primary_findings.quote: Glycemic control also improved, with significant decreases in fasting, postprandial, HbA1c, and random blood glucose (p<0.001).
primary_findings.outcome: fasting, postprandial, HbA1c, and random blood glucose

primary_findings.quote: Treatment led to significant improvements in cardiac function, including reductions in left ventricular diameters and volumes, and increases in ejection fraction, tricuspid annular plane systolic excursion, and right ventricular fractional area change (p<0.05).
primary_findings.outcome: cardiac function (left ventricular diameters, volumes, ejection fraction, TAPSE, RV fractional area change)

primary_findings.quote: Serum creatinine, magnesium, and phosphorus levels increased significantly (p<0.001).
primary_findings.outcome: serum creatinine, magnesium, and phosphorus levels

primary_findings.quote: Adverse events were minimal, with only one patient showing urine acetone positivity (1.5%, p=0.99), and no symptomatic hypoglycemia, ketoacidosis, or significant hypotension occurred.
